item.title: Mr. Xi goes to Washington: Digital Ambition Meets Physical Economic Realities
item.description:
The Chinese leader is in the US...
G’day. If you’re looking for a way to spend 18 hours, Qantas said it’s planning to start selling tickets for direct New York to Sydney flights next year, with the first flights taking off in 2028. That’s just an hour shorter than the world’s current longest flight (New York–Singapore), but it’ll be two hours shorter than the soon-to-be longest, the 20-hour London–Sydney flight Qantas plans to debut next year. None of these flights are recommended for passengers who hog the armrests, take their socks off, or listen to audio without headphones.
